resources.string: Sign in with your SCASP account (demo: STU001 / student123).
Use built-in demo data when the server cannot be reached
Offline demo mode: the server could not be reached, so you are using built-in sample data. Nothing is sent to the server.
Background sync every 15 minutes (notifies you when a waiting-list place becomes a registration)

No courses match. Clear the search and pull down to refresh.

Open requests, highest priority first. Assign and update them in the web application.

Open app settings to allow location
Why SCASP asks for your location
Your position is used once, on this screen, to show how far you are from each campus service. It is not stored or sent to the server. You can still open every service in a map app without it.
Location is switched off on this device. Turn it on in Quick Settings and try again.
